label: Driver licence
description: Licence supplied through the approved identity process.

label: Passport
description: Passport supplied through the approved identity process.

label: Secondary ID
description: Additional identification selected by the broker.

label: Name change evidence
description: Evidence connecting different names on records.

label: Citizenship or residency evidence
description: Evidence of relevant citizenship or residency status; visa requests excluded.

label: Verified ID evidence
description: Certified ID or the result of an approved digital identity check.

label: Recent payslips
description: Latest payslips for the selected employer and requested quantity.

label: Earlier payslips
description: Earlier payslips covering the specified history or dates.

label: Employment contract
description: Contract confirming the relevant employment terms.

label: Employer letter
description: Employer confirmation of role, income, hours or employment status.

label: ATO income statement
description: ATO income statement or PAYG payment summary for the selected year.

label: Salary bank statements
description: Statements showing salary credits for the requested period.

label: Overtime evidence
description: Evidence supporting overtime income being considered.

label: Commission evidence
description: Evidence supporting employment commission income.

label: Bonus evidence
description: Evidence supporting bonus income.

label: Allowance evidence
description: Evidence supporting employment allowances.

label: Salary packaging details
description: Salary packaging or novated lease documents relevant to deductions.

label: Second job evidence
description: Requested employment evidence for another job; identify employer and required files.

label: Employment history
description: Evidence of casual, temporary or contract employment history.

label: Personal tax return
description: Individual return and required schedules for the selected year.

label: Notice of Assessment
description: ATO assessment for the selected person and year.

label: Tax lodgement confirmation
description: Confirmation that the relevant return was lodged, where accepted.

label: Business tax return
description: Return for the named business and financial year.

label: BAS
description: Business Activity Statements for the specified periods.

label: Business bank statements
description: Statements for the named business account and period.

label: Accountant letter and contact details
description: Requested accountant confirmation with their contact details.

label: Partnership tax return and financials
description: Selected partnership return and financial statements; record the required components and years.

label: Trust deed
description: Deed for the named trust.

label: Trust deed amendments
description: Variations or amendments to that trust deed.

label: Trust tax return and financials
description: Selected trust return and financial statements; record required components and years.

label: Lease agreement
description: Current tenancy agreement for the relevant rental property.

label: Rental statements
description: Rental statements for the named property and period.

label: Rental bank statements
description: Bank statements showing rental credits for the relevant property.

label: Government benefit or pension
description: Entitlement statement for the relevant benefit or pension.

label: Benefit or pension bank statements
description: Statements showing benefit or pension credits.

label: Child support agreement
description: Child support assessment, agreement or court order.

label: Foreign income evidence
description: Broker-specified evidence supporting overseas income.

label: Savings statements
description: Statements for the relevant savings account and period.

label: Term deposit statements
description: Statements confirming the relevant term deposit.

label: Super balance statement
description: Superannuation balance evidence where requested; distinct from the removed pension-income item.

label: Rates notice
description: Rates notice for the named property.

label: Asset ownership evidence
description: Broker-specified evidence for another relevant declared asset.

label: Home loan statements
description: Statements for the named existing home loan.

label: Investment loan statements
description: Statements for the named investment-property loan.

label: Credit card statements
description: Statements showing the relevant credit card balance and limit.

label: Personal loan statements
description: Statements for an existing personal loan.

label: Vehicle or equipment loan statements
description: Statements for existing debt; this does not restore the removed vehicle-finance transaction category.

label: Business loan statements
description: Statements for relevant existing business debt.

label: Overdraft statements
description: Statements for an overdraft or line of credit, including its limit.

label: Buy now pay later statements
description: Statements showing relevant buy now pay later commitments.

label: Student loan evidence
description: Evidence of HELP or another relevant student loan.

label: Lease or hire purchase agreement
description: Agreement for a relevant existing finance commitment.

label: Deposit funds statements
description: Statements evidencing the deposit or funds to complete.

label: Savings history
description: Evidence covering the specified savings history.

label: Gift declaration
description: Gift declaration or selected lender gift form.

label: Contract of sale — selling
description: Contract for a property or asset being sold to contribute funds.

label: Contract of sale — buying
description: Contract for the property being purchased.

label: Contract amendments
description: Variations or amendments to the purchase contract.

label: Conveyancer details
description: Solicitor or conveyancer details; information entry rather than mandatory file upload.

label: First home buyer documents
description: Placeholder for scheme-specific requests; exact items must be defined before activation.

label: Building contract
description: Signed contract for the construction project.

label: Progress payment schedule
description: Agreed construction draw or progress-payment schedule.

label: Building plans
description: Plans for the relevant project and revision.

label: Building specifications
description: Specifications describing the proposed build.

label: Building approvals
description: Applicable project approvals or permits.

label: Construction insurance
description: Required builder or construction insurance evidence.

label: Progress payment claim
description: Claim or instruction for the relevant construction draw.

label: Builder invoice
description: Invoice supporting the relevant progress payment.

label: Stage inspection evidence
description: Inspection or valuation evidence for the relevant construction stage.

label: Completion evidence
description: Completion or occupancy evidence for the relevant final stage.
